verses.t: Firm stood the heaven, firm stood the earth, firm stood this universal world. Firm stood the trees that sleep erect: let this thy malady be still.
Of all thy hundred remedies, a thousand remedies combined. This is the surest cure for flux, most excellent to heal disease.
Thou art the stream that Rudra pours, the closest kin of Amrita. Thy name is called Vishānakā: thou sprangest from the Fathers' root, removing illness caused by wind.
